properties.description: Seven cases in one file so the constructor property (`checker`), the Project→rule edge and the two detectors land together or not at all. The two-state key is pinned as behaviour: the acknowledged "none known" gap id and the re-asked one are asserted different, because collapsing them is exactly the "asked once, silenced forever" failure the aggregate-acknowledgement ruling warns about.
properties.name: a_project_is_asked_what_its_artifacts_must_be_in.rs — the artifact-standard question pinned: asked on an empty project, ended by a declaration, "none known" re-asked once when a drawing appears, a drawing that does not say is named, a generating source is not, a mirror is not asked
